{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders and valid revenue (non-null)
completed_and_valid = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_numeric'].notnull())]

# Compute the mean revenue for completed orders with valid revenue
mean_revenue = completed_and_valid['revenue_numeric'].mean()

mean_revenue"}
